name: Usage Monitor
description: Account usage and rate-limit windows (session, weekly, …) of every agent provider that reports them, as a tile and a toolbar mini widget, with background refresh and warning thresholds.

tiles.title: Usage Monitor
tiles.description: Usage windows of every agent provider with a usage hook.

cooldownSeconds.title: Refresh cooldown (seconds)
cooldownSeconds.description: A provider's usage is re-read at most this often (a refresh runs its agent CLI). Minimum 60.

backgroundPollSeconds.title: Background refresh (seconds)
backgroundPollSeconds.description: Refresh in the background at this interval, also while no Usage Monitor tile is open. 0 = off; otherwise at least 300.

warningThreshold.title: Warning threshold (%)
warningThreshold.description: Open Usage Monitor tiles glow once any window reaches this.

criticalThreshold.title: Critical threshold (%)
criticalThreshold.description: A toast warns once when a window crosses this.

miniStyle.title: Mini widget style
miniStyle.description: How the toolbar mini widget shows each usage window.

miniHidden.title: Hidden in the mini widget
miniHidden.description: Providers ("claude-code") or windows ("claude-code/week") the mini widget leaves out. Everything else is shown.
